title: Development of a RAG-based Expert LLM for Clinical Support in Radiation Oncology

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4.1: 'four OpenAI large language models (GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, and GPT-5) across two answer generation strategies: direct response and retrieval-augmented generation'

prompt.location: Supplemental Table 1 (not in the main text); 'reproducible scripts are available upon request'

claim.metric: accuracy (%) on the 2021 ACR TXIT exam, RAG with textbook + NCCN
claim.location: Sec. 4.2 text (GPT-4-turbo 77.32% textbook+NCCN; 79.38% with PMC); direct-answer value only in Figure 3

data.source: ACR TXIT 2021 in-training exam (text questions) and a copyrighted textbook + NCCN knowledge base

notes: Direct-answer accuracy for GPT-4-turbo appears only in Figure 3 ('increased by over 5 percentage points' with RAG). Exam items and the retrieval corpus are not redistributable; question count not stated.
